fact: Article 21 of decree-law 2022-2 of 4 January 2022 bars credit information companies from transferring their databases, or setting up sites to protect the data given to them, outside Tunisia, and bars them from hosting credit information in the cloud.

The communications ministry says G-Cloud labels, awarded in July 2024 under decree-law 2023-17 and a ministerial decision of 13 September 2023, go only to Tunisian hosting providers linked to the administration's network, as part of the 2025 digital strategy to guarantee digital sovereignty.
